Twelve Norwegian EUMETNET/OPERA single-site volumes now pair reflectivity with their matching velocity scans; eleven publish velocity about one minute later and Rissa includes it at the same timestamp. Eleven Finnish EUMETNET/OPERA sites now use the same five-elevation SCAN assembly, with their local Helsinki timezone. SCAN assembly now renumbers each radial together with its sweep, so higher elevation cuts remain selectable in the viewer. Four Slovak sites assemble separate reflectivity and velocity PVOL objects only after the pair is complete. Dublin assembles eight public reflectivity SCAN cuts across each five-minute cycle and adds all ten velocity elevations from its separate 15-minute PVOL; the tilt picker shows only cuts available for the selected product.
